inputs: Only prospective-output-protocol.json12 new scenes;26turns/arm, including13-turn writing chain.
order: Even scene indices baseline then candidate; odd indices candidate then baseline. Fresh owned DB and application server each arm. Models run separately and sequentially; archive/commit one model before starting the next.
implementation: Actual application HTTP/SSE. Only candidate replaces the process-local Avatar factory with lab subclass; production CLI/default remains native. No model prompt/weights/sampling change.
source_freeze: After implementation and CPU checks, create hash manifest binding core/lab/evaluator/runner/protocol and test evidence before any prospective model call.
evidence: Every event and visible/final text, all turn profiles/messages/reminders, request IDs, native provider call IDs/raw text/finish reason/offsets
Reviewer rule/codepoint spans and creative flags; distinguish native llm, bounded reviewed_response, deterministic routes and failures
Per-model actual GPU/PID/startup/clean shutdown; only owned processes
First visible and complete latency, reply length and generation modes by model/arm; observational, not pure hardware causality

gates.engineering: All24 scene-arms per model terminate without service fallback, native/reviewed visible text exactly final including empty-stream rejection; source unchanged; no unexpected reminders or tool calls.
gates.intercepted_stream: When bounded review changes reply, never publish original intercepted text or commit it as assistant; generic verifier staysFalse.
gates.preservation: Unchanged candidate replies preserve native bytes; preserve writing/fiction/role/negative/online controls. Check literal requests and profile-source differences separately from body correction.
gates.semantic: Agent span review is not independent human gold or model self-score; report explicit misses/ambiguity. Lexical/rule hits do not prove general semantics.
gates.activation: Still no production activation; source-unverified deferred reply may remain unsafe (G2C16-002), body/ownership/SMS quality open. Preserve v1 and all failures.

analytic_contract: source-bound-context-protocol.json + http-restart-protocol.json; C15 failed outputs only known regression
validation_reuse: Do not tune v1 using prospective outputs and then claim them independent; subsequent revisions require a new frozen validation plan.
